display_name: 输入自适应相位因子的源域可行性
description: 以单独的旋转不变量网络，学习不变与抵消输入相位的混合规则；源域冻结 DURA 仅提供复增益相位代理目标。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python GPU3 if idle, two CPU threads

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels or U_s truth read; frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL predictions guide source training
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 day3 source IDs for selection and 3921 RX8 day3 heldout; cache16; physical IDs previously seen in other source experiments
data.leo_config_ref: Fixed source cache epochs1–3 training, epoch16 selection; six impaired Phase1 simulated scenes

permissions.query_use: Source-only phase proxy experiment; no V, no test IQ, no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed, source heldout and Phase1 development previously observed, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random input adaptive phase factor; frozen source gate and DURA source teacher only
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned parent release a90a5e381c19e94455bfafd9c67321833c764491, gate c905f3ab3d7f0d121e2c44c3b0bfb26188fa5825
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source RX4/6 source-epoch16 active impaired scenes: mean cosine loss <=95% of identity, each scene/receiver loss <=identity+.05; best of epochs1–3; heldout RX8 not used

execution.gpu_policy: GPU3 only if idle; one worker, two CPU threads

execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance, role, output collision, nonfinite or technical execution failure; preserve partial results

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Proxy alignment to source DURA phase is not Phase1 classification improvement or satisfaction of 3% goal.

rows.method: input-only invariant/equivariant phase-factor mixture; DURA used only to derive source proxy target
rows.purpose: test source feasibility of condition-adaptive phase behavior
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source split seed 2026110551; model 2026111454; shuffle 2026111455; training cache1–3, selection cache16
rows.scenario: source six impaired simulated scenes; no Phase1 target data
rows.budget_ref: 47143 source training IDs, gate-active subset, batch32, 3 epochs; 7840/3921 source selection and heldout physical IDs
rows.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261102-phase1-adaptive-phase-factor-s2026092701-r01-release/experiments/phase1_adaptive_phase_factor/phase_factor_pipeline.py --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --run-root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261102-phase1-adaptive-phase-factor-s2026092701-r01 --commit f8a2f526d67e21757c6972124403b6c3078e8d5b --device cuda:0

notes: DURA source teacher and frozen gate only; model deploy input is IQ alone.
F is not loaded here; eventual network must use frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.

Source phase proxy is not classification accuracy; RX4/6 and RX8 identities previously examined under other views.
